subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can name sports with go, play and do.
I can find the sport from clues in a short text.
I can sort sports into groups and say why we do sports.

tf.why: Yes! We use go with swimming.
Correct! We use do with karate.
Yes, we go skiing on snow.

tf.s: Cycling uses wheels and a helmet.
tf.why: Right! A bike has wheels and you wear a helmet.

tf.s: Sports can help keep us healthy.
tf.why: Great! Sports keep us fit and healthy.

tf.s: You play table tennis with big bats and a big ball.
tf.why: Table tennis uses small bats and a small ball.
Yes, you play hockey in a team.

boxes.q: Which do you use on snow?
boxes.why: You go skiing on snow with skis.

boxes.q: "We play it indoors and on the beach." What is it?
boxes.why: You can play volleyball indoors or on the beach.

boxes.q: What do you wear on your head when you cycle?
boxes.why: A helmet keeps your head safe.

boxes.q: What do you need for table tennis?

mcq.q: Which verb do we use with volleyball, hockey and badminton?
mcq.why: We play ball and racket games.

mcq.q: Which sport do we use with "do"?
Which list has two winter sports?
mcq.why: Skiing and ice skating are winter sports.

mcq.q: In Julia's post, which sport uses wheels and a helmet?
mcq.why: Cycling uses wheels and a helmet.

o: I go cycling with my brother.
I play cycling with my brother.
I do cycling with my brother.
I go hockey with my brother.

mcq.q: Which list has one sport with go, one with play and one with do?
o: go cycling, play table tennis, do gymnastics
go hockey, play karate, do swimming
go volleyball, play skiing, do cycling
go karate, play gymnastics, do hockey
mcq.why: Each verb matches its sport here.

mcq.q: "You do it in water. You don't need a ball." Which sport is it?
mcq.why: Water and no ball means swimming.

mcq.q: Which clue tells you Reem's sport is table tennis?
o: She uses small bats, a small ball and a big table.
mcq.why: Small bats and a big table point to table tennis.

mcq.q: Hockey, karate, volleyball: which is NOT a team sport?
Which is a good answer to the WOW! Question "Why do we do sports?"
o: They keep us fit and help us make new friends.
They make us tired and bored.
Because skiing is a winter sport.
mcq.why: Sports keep us healthy and help us make friends.
